items.q: What should I bring to a weed dispensary in Jersey City?
items.a_html: Bring a valid government-issued photo ID that shows you are 21 or older. Under New Jersey's rules, a dispensary checks photo ID before letting you in and again before each sale, and it may not keep a copy of your ID. Greenstop accepts cash and may also accept debit cards; call 201.604.1281 to confirm current payment options before you visit. Sources: New Jersey Cannabis Regulatory Commission, N.J.A.C. 17:30.

items.q: Do I need a medical card to buy weed at a New Jersey dispensary?
items.a_html: No, not for recreational cannabis. In New Jersey, anyone 21 or older, resident or visitor, can buy recreational cannabis at a licensed dispensary; a Medicinal Cannabis Program ID is needed only to buy from a dispensary's medical menu. Greenstop is a recreational dispensary, so bring a valid government-issued ID that shows you are 21 or older. Registered patients can read about the state program in our medical cannabis guide. Sources: New Jersey Cannabis Regulatory Commission, General Information FAQ, Patient FAQs.

items.q: Can I buy weed in Jersey City if I'm visiting from New York or another state?
items.a_html: Yes. Anyone 21 or older, New Jersey resident or visitor, can buy cannabis at a licensed New Jersey dispensary with a valid government-issued ID. You cannot take it home across state lines, though: transporting cannabis across state lines is still illegal. Sources: New Jersey Cannabis Regulatory Commission, General Information FAQ.

items.q: How much cannabis can I buy at once in New Jersey?
items.a_html: In each transaction, a New Jersey dispensary may sell you up to the equivalent of 1 ounce (28.35 grams) of usable cannabis. That means up to 28.35 grams of dried flower, or 4 grams of solid concentrate or resin (or the liquid equivalent), or edibles with up to 1,000 mg of THC in total, such as ten 100 mg packages of gummies. You can combine products, for example half an ounce of flower with 2 grams of concentrate, and dispensaries must make a good-faith effort to stop customers from going over one ounce across multiple transactions. For vapes, the Commission lists 4 grams of vaporized formulations (oil), a cap the state rules express as no more than 4 mL of oil. Sources: New Jersey Cannabis Regulatory Commission, N.J.A.C. 17:30. More in our guide to recreational cannabis in New Jersey.

items.q: Where can I legally smoke weed in New Jersey?
items.a_html: Generally, adults 21 and older can use cannabis on private property, but property owners can limit its use and landlords can prohibit it. Cannabis smoking is allowed where cigarette smoking is permitted, unless stated otherwise, but New Jersey's Smoke Free Air Act prohibits smoking of any kind in most public spaces, and the state rules do not permit smoking or vaping cannabis anywhere a federal, state or local law prohibits smoking tobacco. You can also consume cannabis at licensed dispensaries with consumption areas, which admit only patrons 21 or older with photo ID. Greenstop's home page lists a Consume Place as coming soon. Never drive high: driving under the influence of cannabis is illegal in New Jersey. Sources: New Jersey Cannabis Regulatory Commission, General Information FAQ, Patient FAQs, N.J.A.C. 17:30, Don't Drive High.
